## `615496fbe17b`

The canonical rule selects the unique nonzero object whose enclosed-hole count decreases after one clipped 3×3 dilation, then crops the original object and recolors its occupied cells 8. The repaired production generator now rejects unknown controls, validates exact overrides, samples the declared palette kinds, guarantees whole-scene placement through deterministic retry packing, and checks the actual hole-sealing predicate rather than a weaker proxy.

The alternate `persistent` setting selects the unique object that still has an enclosed hole after dilation. Step A computes per-object hole metrics and the selected object index; step B must consume that index to crop and repaint the original cells. The replayed counterfactual uses the wrong setting's selected index and changes the final crop.
